lines.text: Many learners say: He is more taller than me.
Better: He is taller than me.
Taller! She is taller than her brother.

data.wrong: He is more taller than me.

native.tip: Türkçede “daha uzun” deriz; İngilizcede kısa sıfata -er gelir, “more” eklenmez: “taller”.
native.caption: “He is more taller than me” mi diyorsun? 😅 Doğrusu “He is taller than me.” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “taller”. Kısa sıfatta -er yeter, more gerekmez. Ücretsiz testle pratik yap: {link}

en.caption: Do you say “He is more taller than me”? 😅 English adds -er to short words, without “more”. The right sentence is “He is taller than me.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
